decision.reason: [ev-a5b549ff42a5] says only that flags were added to `admin import` for retrying updates on conflicts and for skipping resources with specific labels. It does not name either flag, so the spelling "--retry-on-conflict" (and the component "admin") are guesses rather than text copied from the evidence. The evidence does support the change type "added". Deciding the subject needs the flag names from PR #21694 or from the `argocd admin import` CLI reference.
